Representing Surrey in this latter meeting Cliff Brooks placed 2nd over the 400m hurdles in 56.0 and Ernie Obeng again had the beating of Danny Laing but was in turn beaten by the Army's S.Hall - both recorded 10.8 for the 100m.

He qualified for the 100m final with the fastest time and then sped to a 10.9 victory over South London's Danny Laing, 11.1. In the 200m Ernie impressively took his heat in 21.9, six metres clear of Croydon's ace sprinter Bob Benn, but come the final which was the last event in the nine hour program…
Ernie Obeng collected both sprints into the wind, his enormous bounding stride seeming to defy gravity, and outstanding as SLH's Danny Laing is he had to settle for two 2nds.
